message.reasoning_content:
We need to classify relation between two yes/no questions extracted from same actor at different times. Questions:

1. "A regulamentação do lobby junto ao poder público deve ser avançada?" (Should the regulation of lobbying with public power be advanced?)

2. "A regulamentação do trabalho de motoristas de aplicativo deve ser aprovada com pressa?" (Should the regulation of app drivers' work be approved urgently?)

These are different topics: lobbying regulation vs regulation of app drivers. Different objects, measures. So DIFFERENT.

We must output JSON with relation and reasoning.
